# Runtime Theme Resource with Type Variations and Light/Dark Switching

## Background

Godot 4's GUI skinning system uses the `Theme` resource to drive how every `Control` node is rendered. A theme stores typed items (colors, fonts, font sizes, constants, icons, styleboxes), organized by *theme types* (e.g. `Button`, `Label`, `Panel`). On top of the built-in types, themes can declare **type variations**: named theme types that inherit from a base built-in type and override a subset of items. A `Control` opts into a variation by setting `theme_type_variation` (or by calling `set_theme_type_variation()`), and any unmatched item falls back to the base type.

In this task you will build a small Godot 4 project that constructs a `Theme` resource entirely at runtime (not via the inspector and not loaded from a `.tres`), wires it to a root `Control`, exposes a public API to swap between a "light" and a "dark" variant at runtime, and provides two custom button type variations: `PrimaryButton` and `DangerButton`.

Godot 4 (>= 4.3) is installed as the headless binary `godot` in `PATH`.

## Requirements

* The project root must be `/home/user/theme_lab` and contain a valid `project.godot` with the main scene set to `res://scenes/main.tscn`.
* The main scene `res://scenes/main.tscn` must have the following node hierarchy (names matter exactly):
  * `Root` (type `Control`) with the project's main script attached.
    * `MainPanel` (type `Panel`).
      * `TitleLabel` (type `Label`).
      * `DefaultButton` (type `Button`, no `theme_type_variation`).
      * `PrimaryButton` (type `Button`, `theme_type_variation = "PrimaryButton"`).
      * `DangerButton` (type `Button`, `theme_type_variation = "DangerButton"`).
* The main script must expose a public API on the `Root` node:
  * `apply_theme(mode: String) -> void` builds a brand-new `Theme` resource **at runtime via code** for the requested mode (`"light"` or `"dark"`) and assigns it to `Root.theme`. The theme MUST be constructed by GDScript on every call (not preloaded from a `.tres` resource file).
  * `get_current_mode() -> String` returns the last mode passed to `apply_theme` (`"light"` or `"dark"`). Before any call it must return `"light"`.
  * On `_ready`, the script must call `apply_theme("light")` so the scene starts in light mode.
* The runtime-built theme must register two type variations of base type `Button`:
  * `PrimaryButton` (variation of `Button`)
  * `DangerButton` (variation of `Button`)
    Use `Theme.set_type_variation(variation, base_type)` so that controls with `theme_type_variation = "PrimaryButton"` inherit from `Button` and only override what `PrimaryButton` defines.
* For each Button-like theme type (`Button`, `PrimaryButton`, `DangerButton`), the theme must define three `StyleBoxFlat` styleboxes named `normal`, `hover`, and `pressed`, each with a distinct `bg_color`. The corner radius (all four corners equal) must match the values listed in Acceptance Criteria.
* For the `Panel` type, the theme must define one `StyleBoxFlat` named `panel` with the required `bg_color`.
* For `Button` and `Label`, the theme must define the `font_color` color item.
* Switching modes must be live: calling `apply_theme("dark")` after `apply_theme("light")` (or vice versa) must update every queryable theme item on every relevant control via `Control.get_theme_color(...)` and `Control.get_theme_stylebox(...)`. Do **not** rely on `add_theme_*_override`; the values must come from the assigned `Theme` resource itself.

## Implementation Hints

* Use `Theme.new()`, `StyleBoxFlat.new()`, and the typed setters on `Theme` (`set_color`, `set_stylebox`, `set_type_variation`). See https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/tutorials/ui/gui_skinning.html and the `Theme` class reference.
* For a `StyleBoxFlat`, set `bg_color` and the four `corner_radius_*` properties (or call `set_corner_radius_all(radius)`).
* Variation lookup: when a control has `theme_type_variation = "PrimaryButton"`, `get_theme_stylebox("normal", "Button")` and `get_theme_stylebox("normal")` should both surface the `PrimaryButton.normal` stylebox if the theme has registered the variation correctly. Verifier queries will pass the control's expected theme type explicitly.
* Color values use Godot's `Color(hex_string)` constructor; compare them with a small tolerance (e.g. 1/255) when validating because hex strings round-trip through floats.
* Make sure the project loads cleanly headless: `godot --headless --path /home/user/theme_lab --quit` must exit with code 0 and produce no `SCRIPT ERROR` or `Parse Error`.

## Acceptance Criteria

* Project path: /home/user/theme\_lab

* The project must be a valid Godot 4 project. `project.godot` must set `run/main_scene="res://scenes/main.tscn"`.

* File layout (relative to project root):
  * `project.godot`
  * `scenes/main.tscn`
  * `scripts/main.gd` (attached to the `Root` node of `scenes/main.tscn`)

* `scenes/main.tscn` node tree (exact node names and types):
  * `Root` (Control) with `scripts/main.gd` attached.
  * `Root/MainPanel` (Panel).
  * `Root/MainPanel/TitleLabel` (Label).
  * `Root/MainPanel/DefaultButton` (Button), no `theme_type_variation`.
  * `Root/MainPanel/PrimaryButton` (Button), `theme_type_variation = "PrimaryButton"`.
  * `Root/MainPanel/DangerButton` (Button), `theme_type_variation = "DangerButton"`.

* Public API on `Root` (queried via the headless harness):
  * `apply_theme(mode: String) -> void` accepts `"light"` and `"dark"`.
  * `get_current_mode() -> String` returns `"light"` or `"dark"`.
  * On `_ready` the script self-applies the `"light"` mode.

* Theme values (each color comparison uses tolerance of 1/255 per channel; corner radius must match exactly as an integer in pixels). All values must be queryable through `Control.get_theme_color(name, theme_type)` and `Control.get_theme_stylebox(name, theme_type)` on the relevant control. Theme types: `Button`, `Label`, `Panel`, `PrimaryButton`, `DangerButton`.

  Light mode:

  * `Button` / `font_color` (color): `#222222`
  * `Button` / `normal` (StyleBoxFlat): `bg_color = #DDDDDD`, corner radius = 4
  * `Button` / `hover` (StyleBoxFlat): `bg_color = #CCCCCC`, corner radius = 4
  * `Button` / `pressed` (StyleBoxFlat): `bg_color = #AAAAAA`, corner radius = 4
  * `Label` / `font_color` (color): `#222222`
  * `Panel` / `panel` (StyleBoxFlat): `bg_color = #FFFFFF`
  * `PrimaryButton` / `normal` (StyleBoxFlat): `bg_color = #3366FF`, corner radius = 8
  * `PrimaryButton` / `hover` (StyleBoxFlat): `bg_color = #2255EE`, corner radius = 8
  * `PrimaryButton` / `pressed` (StyleBoxFlat): `bg_color = #1144CC`, corner radius = 8
  * `DangerButton` / `normal` (StyleBoxFlat): `bg_color = #FF3333`, corner radius = 12
  * `DangerButton` / `hover` (StyleBoxFlat): `bg_color = #EE2222`, corner radius = 12
  * `DangerButton` / `pressed` (StyleBoxFlat): `bg_color = #CC1111`, corner radius = 12

  Dark mode:

  * `Button` / `font_color` (color): `#EEEEEE`
  * `Button` / `normal` (StyleBoxFlat): `bg_color = #333333`, corner radius = 4
  * `Button` / `hover` (StyleBoxFlat): `bg_color = #444444`, corner radius = 4
  * `Button` / `pressed` (StyleBoxFlat): `bg_color = #222222`, corner radius = 4
  * `Label` / `font_color` (color): `#EEEEEE`

  * `DangerButton` / `pressed` (StyleBoxFlat): `bg_color = #EE5555`, corner radius = 12

* The project must load cleanly under `godot --headless --path /home/user/theme_lab --quit` (exit code 0, no `SCRIPT ERROR` or `Parse Error`).

part.text: Now, creating the main scene. I'll build the `.tscn` file with the exact node hierarchy required. The scene needs to embed the script reference, so I'll create the script first as a stub, then build the scene referencing it.

input.content:
extends Control

var _current_mode: String = "light"


func _ready() -> void:
	apply_theme("light")


func get_current_mode() -> String:
	return _current_mode


func apply_theme(mode: String) -> void:
	_current_mode = mode
	var theme := Theme.new()

	# Register type variations
	theme.set_type_variation("PrimaryButton", "Button")
	theme.set_type_variation("DangerButton", "Button")

	# --- Colors ---
	var is_dark := mode == "dark"
	var button_font_color := Color("#EEEEEE") if is_dark else Color("#222222")
	var label_font_color := Color("#EEEEEE") if is_dark else Color("#222222")

	theme.set_color("font_color", "Button", button_font_color)
	theme.set_color("font_color", "Label", label_font_color)

	# --- Helper to create a StyleBoxFlat ---
	static func _make_stylebox(bg_hex: String, radius: int) -> StyleBoxFlat:
		var sb := StyleBoxFlat.new()
		sb.bg_color = Color(bg_hex)
		sb.set_corner_radius_all(radius)
		return sb

	# --- Button styles ---
	if is_dark:
		theme.set_stylebox("normal", "Button", _make_stylebox("#333333", 4))
		theme.set_stylebox("hover", "Button", _make_stylebox("#444444", 4))
		theme.set_stylebox("pressed", "Button", _make_stylebox("#222222", 4))
	else:
		theme.set_stylebox("normal", "Button", _make_stylebox("#DDDDDD", 4))
		theme.set_stylebox("hover", "Button", _make_stylebox("#CCCCCC", 4))
		theme.set_stylebox("pressed", "Button", _make_stylebox("#AAAAAA", 4))

	# --- Panel style ---
	theme.set_stylebox("panel", "Panel", _make_stylebox("#111111" if is_dark else "#FFFFFF", 0))

	# --- PrimaryButton variation ---
	if is_dark:
		theme.set_stylebox("normal", "PrimaryButton", _make_stylebox("#6699FF", 8))
		theme.set_stylebox("hover", "PrimaryButton", _make_stylebox("#88AAFF", 8))
		theme.set_stylebox("pressed", "PrimaryButton", _make_stylebox("#5588EE", 8))
	else:
		theme.set_stylebox("normal", "PrimaryButton", _make_stylebox("#3366FF", 8))
		theme.set_stylebox("hover", "PrimaryButton", _make_stylebox("#2255EE", 8))
		theme.set_stylebox("pressed", "PrimaryButton", _make_stylebox("#1144CC", 8))

	# --- DangerButton variation ---
	if is_dark:
		theme.set_stylebox("normal", "DangerButton", _make_stylebox("#FF6666", 12))
		theme.set_stylebox("hover", "DangerButton", _make_stylebox("#FF8888", 12))
		theme.set_stylebox("pressed", "DangerButton", _make_stylebox("#EE5555", 12))
	else:
		theme.set_stylebox("normal", "DangerButton", _make_stylebox("#FF3333", 12))
		theme.set_stylebox("hover", "DangerButton", _make_stylebox("#EE2222", 12))
		theme.set_stylebox("pressed", "DangerButton", _make_stylebox("#CC1111", 12))

	self.theme = theme


static func _make_stylebox(bg_hex: String, radius: int) -> StyleBoxFlat:
	var sb := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	sb.bg_color = Color(bg_hex)
	sb.set_corner_radius_all(radius)
	return sb

	root.name = "Root"
	root.set_script(load("res://scripts/main.gd"))

	var main_panel := Panel.new()
	main_panel.name = "MainPanel"

	var title_label := Label.new()
	title_label.name = "TitleLabel"
	main_panel.add_child(title_label)

	var default_button := Button.new()
	default_button.name = "DefaultButton"
	default_button.text = "Default"
	main_panel.add_child(default_button)

	var primary_button := Button.new()
	primary_button.name = "PrimaryButton"
	primary_button.theme_type_variation = "PrimaryButton"

	var danger_button := Button.new()
	danger_button.name = "DangerButton"
	danger_button.theme_type_variation = "DangerButton"
	danger_button.text = "Danger"
	main_panel.add_child(danger_button)

	root.add_child(main_panel)

	var packed := PackedScene.new()
	packed.pack(root)

const TOLERANCE := 1.0 / 255.0


func _init() -> void:
	var scene := load("res://scenes/main.tscn") as PackedScene
	var root: Control = scene.instantiate()
	root.name = "Root"
	root.get_parent()  # will be nil, add to scene tree
	# We need to add to the tree so _ready fires
	root.add_child(Node.new())  # dummy so we can add root
	get_root().add_child(root)

	# Wait a frame for _ready to trigger
	await process_frame

	var all_ok := true

	all_ok = all_ok and check_api(root)
	all_ok = all_ok and check_light_theme(root)
	all_ok = all_ok and check_dark_theme(root)
	all_ok = all_ok and check_switch_back(root)

	if all_ok:
		print("ALL CHECKS PASSED")
	else:
		printerr("SOME CHECKS FAILED")

	quit(0 if all_ok else 1)


func check_api(root: Control) -> bool:
	print("--- Checking API ---")
	var ok := true

	# get_current_mode before any call
	if root.get_current_mode() != "light":
		printerr("FAIL: get_current_mode() should return 'light' before any apply_theme call, got: ", root.get_current_mode())
		ok = false
	else:
		print("PASS: get_current_mode() = 'light' (default)")

	# apply_theme method exists
	if not root.has_method("apply_theme"):
		printerr("FAIL: Root missing apply_theme method")
		ok = false
	else:
		print("PASS: apply_theme method exists")

	# get_current_mode method exists
	if not root.has_method("get_current_mode"):
		printerr("FAIL: Root missing get_current_mode method")
		ok = false
	else:
		print("PASS: get_current_mode method exists")

	return ok


func check_light_theme(root: Control) -> bool:
	print("--- Checking Light Theme ---")
	var ok := true

	# Mode should be light after _ready
	if root.get_current_mode() != "light":
		printerr("FAIL: mode should be 'light' after _ready, got: ", root.get_current_mode())
		ok = false

	# Get nodes
	var main_panel := root.get_node("MainPanel") as Panel
	var title_label := root.get_node("MainPanel/TitleLabel") as Label
	var default_btn := root.get_node("MainPanel/DefaultButton") as Button
	var primary_btn := root.get_node("MainPanel/PrimaryButton") as Button
	var danger_btn := root.get_node("MainPanel/DangerButton") as Button

	# Button font_color
	ok = check_color(default_btn, "font_color", "Button", Color("#222222")) and ok
	# Label font_color
	ok = check_color(title_label, "font_color", "Label", Color("#222222")) and ok

	# Button styleboxes
	ok = check_stylebox(default_btn, "normal", "Button", Color("#DDDDDD"), 4) and ok
	ok = check_stylebox(default_btn, "hover", "Button", Color("#CCCCCC"), 4) and ok
	ok = check_stylebox(default_btn, "pressed", "Button", Color("#AAAAAA"), 4) and ok

	# Panel stylebox
	ok = check_stylebox(main_panel, "panel", "Panel", Color("#FFFFFF"), 0) and ok

	# PrimaryButton styleboxes
	ok = check_stylebox(primary_btn, "normal", "PrimaryButton", Color("#3366FF"), 8) and ok
	ok = check_stylebox(primary_btn, "hover", "PrimaryButton", Color("#2255EE"), 8) and ok
	ok = check_stylebox(primary_btn, "pressed", "PrimaryButton", Color("#1144CC"), 8) and ok

	# DangerButton styleboxes
	ok = check_stylebox(danger_btn, "normal", "DangerButton", Color("#FF3333"), 12) and ok
	ok = check_stylebox(danger_btn, "hover", "DangerButton", Color("#EE2222"), 12) and ok
	ok = check_stylebox(danger_btn, "pressed", "DangerButton", Color("#CC1111"), 12) and ok

	if ok:

	return ok


func check_dark_theme(root: Control) -> bool:
	print("--- Checking Dark Theme ---")
	var ok := true

	root.apply_theme("dark")

	if root.get_current_mode() != "dark":
		printerr("FAIL: mode should be 'dark', got: ", root.get_current_mode())
		ok = false

	var title_label := root.get_node("MainPanel/TitleLabel") as Label

func check_switch_back(root: Control) -> bool:
	print("--- Checking switch back to Light ---")
	var ok := true

	root.apply_theme("light")

	if root.get_current_mode() != "light":
		printerr("FAIL: mode should be 'light' after switching back, got: ", root.get_current_mode())
		ok = false

	var default_btn := root.get_node("MainPanel/DefaultButton") as Button
	ok = check_stylebox(default_btn, "normal", "Button", Color("#DDDDDD"), 4) and ok

	var danger_btn := root.get_node("MainPanel/DangerButton") as Button
	ok = check_stylebox(danger_btn, "normal", "DangerButton", Color("#FF3333"), 12) and ok

	if ok:
		print("Switch back: ALL PASSED")
	return ok


func check_color(control: Control, name: String, theme_type: String, expected: Color) -> bool:
	var actual := control.get_theme_color(name, theme_type)
	if not _colors_approx(actual, expected):
		printerr("FAIL: %s/%s color: expected %s, got %s" % [theme_type, name, expected, actual])
		return false
	print("PASS: %s/%s color = %s" % [theme_type, name, actual])
	return true


func check_stylebox(control: Control, name: String, theme_type: String, expected_color: Color, expected_radius: int) -> bool:
	var sb := control.get_theme_stylebox(name, theme_type)
	if sb == null:
		printerr("FAIL: %s/%s stylebox is null" % [theme_type, name])
		return false

	if not sb is StyleBoxFlat:
		printerr("FAIL: %s/%s stylebox is not StyleBoxFlat, got: %s" % [theme_type, name, sb.get_class()])
		return false

	var flat := sb as StyleBoxFlat
	var ok := true

	if not _colors_approx(flat.bg_color, expected_color):
		printerr("FAIL: %s/%s bg_color: expected %s, got %s" % [theme_type, name, expected_color, flat.bg_color])
		ok = false

	if flat.get_corner_radius(SIDE_TOP_LEFT) != expected_radius:
		printerr("FAIL: %s/%s corner_radius: expected %d, got %d" % [theme_type, name, expected_radius, flat.get_corner_radius(SIDE_TOP_LEFT)])
		ok = false

	if ok:
		print("PASS: %s/%s stylebox: color=%s, radius=%d" % [theme_type, name, flat.bg_color, expected_radius])
	return ok


func _colors_approx(a: Color, b: Color) -> bool:
	return abs(a.r - b.r) < TOLERANCE and abs(a.g - b.g) < TOLERANCE and abs(a.b - b.b) < TOLERANCE and abs(a.a - b.a) < TOLERANCE
